snip.t: The most common neurologic manifestations of TSC consist of epilepsy, cognitive impairment, and autism spectrum disorder.\nTSC may present during infancy with infantile spasms and a hypsarrhythmic electroencephalogram pattern.
45% of individuals with TSC have intellectual disability, and up to 50% have autism spectrum disorder.
